column1: # snapshot: same-change identity refreshes over the frozen residual prose-pin manifest
# contract: each row declares one RETAIN_BOUNDARY identity frozen in that manifest and the
# contract: assertion name the tree now carries for it. The manifest row itself is never edited:
# contract: its identity set is pinned to the base revision's committed pin-corpus inventory, so
# contract: an edit there would break the historical partition permanently. A row is admitted
# contract: only when the old identity is gone from the tree and the new one is present, so a
# contract: rename and its re-freeze land in the same commit and a refresh cannot outlive it.
